skill.summary: Analyze retrieved Zhihu comments and replies to identify pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and practical recommendations.

security_audit.summary: One finding is confirmed: the CLI example automatically executes an unpinned external npm package with access to the configured API key. The other 35 findings concern Markdown notation, documented authentication, service links, comment identifiers, or readable Chinese text rather than their reported threats. No evidence found of prompt injection or deliberate credential exfiltration in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not supplied.

remediation.issue: The CLI example uses npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, allowing automatic execution of changing external code.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and verify package integrity before execution. Obtain installation consent and use an isolated environment with only required credentials.

content.user_title: Analyze Zhihu Comments for User Insights
content.value_statement: Zhihu discussions can contain scattered feedback that is difficult to compare. This skill organizes retrieved comments and replies into themes, concerns, needs, and actionable recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve comments from a supplied Zhihu answer, article, or video URL through the documented SocialDataX CLI or available MCP tools.
Retrieve replies using the content URL and a known parent comment ID.
Collect multiple pages using continuation tokens, page limits, or item limits.
Organize returned comments into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ candidates.
Separate visible comment evidence from interpretation and report the sample coverage.
Preserve partial results and resume pagination while retaining the original collection limits.
limitations: Requires a configured SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, service access, and sufficient account balance.
CLI use requires Node.js, npm, network access, and an external package that is not bundled with these skill files.
Findings cover only returned comments and replies, not all Zhihu users or the entire platform.
The documented workflow does not log in, publish content, like posts, submit comments, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Identify Product Improvement Leads
use_cases.description: Group recurring complaints and unmet needs from a supplied discussion, with visible evidence and practical follow-up questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Follow-Up Content
use_cases.description: Extract recurring audience questions and discussion themes to guide future topics and FAQ updates.

use_cases.title: Review Purchase Concerns
use_cases.description: Summarize purchase objections and service expectations from returned comments without treating the sample as representative market research.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Discussion
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first page of comments for [Zhihu content URL]. Summarize themes and questions, quote visible evidence, and state the sample limits.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Pain Points and FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to two comment pages for [Zhihu content URL]. Group pain points and purchase concerns, then propose FAQ answers. Separate evidence from interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn a bounded sample into structured feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Examine a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve up to 50 replies for [comment ID] under [Zhihu content URL]. Explain recurring disagreements and unmet needs. Use only visible quotes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate a specific parent comment.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: For [Zhihu content URL], collect at most three pages and 150 comments. Investigate [research question] and retrieve at most 20 replies per selected thread. Report themes, evidence, coverage, and next actions. Preserve partial results and request approval before expanding limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: conduct a controlled research workflow.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize a first-page sample about a software subscription.
output: Illustrative result, not live retrieval: the sample contains questions about trial restrictions and cancellation.
Purchase concern: uncertainty about recurring charges. Validate this interpretation against the returned comment text.
Suggested action: clarify cancellation terms and trial limits in the FAQ.
Coverage: first-page sample only; no claim about all Zhihu users.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: review a reply thread about a product setup problem.
output: Illustrative result, not live retrieval: replies discuss confusing setup steps.
Possible unmet need: clearer onboarding guidance.
Suggested action: test a revised setup checklist with affected users.
Coverage: one selected thread; evidence and interpretation remain separate.

best_practices: Use a reviewed, pinned CLI package version and configure the API key without sharing its value in prompts or reports.
Start with one page, set collection limits, and request approval before expanding retrieval or spending.
Quote only returned comments, separate evidence from interpretation, and state coverage and partial-result limits.
anti_patterns: Treating a limited comment sample as representative of the entire Zhihu platform.
Inventing quotes, feedback counts, or purchase intent that the returned comments do not support.
Using unlimited collection or restarting partial retrieval without checking limits, progress, and potential service charges.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide a supported Zhihu content URL or share text. Reply retrieval also requires a parent comment ID.

faq.question: What must I configure before retrieval?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure service access and sufficient balance. CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.

faq.question: Can it analyze replies as well as comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented reply command and MCP tool use a content URL and parent comment ID.

faq.question: Does the report represent all Zhihu users?
faq.answer: No. Conclusions apply only to the comments and replies returned for the supplied content and collection limits.

faq.question: Can this skill post or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes posting or account changes. The supplied files do not include the external CLI implementation.

faq.question: How should incomplete retrieval be handled?
faq.answer: Preserve returned items and report incomplete coverage. Resume only with a valid continuation token, retaining the original page and item limits.
